learning_outcomes.text: Explain the concepts of basic machine elements and stress-strain relationships.
It can calculate the strength of members using design parameters such as factor of safety, notch effect, surface and size factors.
When selecting materials, the most suitable material can be determined by taking into account mechanical properties, fatigue strength and manufacturing conditions.
Be able to make basic strength calculations for joining methods such as soldering, gluing, welding and riveting.
It can perform the design/calculations of standard machine elements such as bolts, pins, pins, wedges and springs.
It can calculate appropriate diameter and strength by analyzing the bending, torsion and combined loading conditions that occur on the axles and shafts.

syllabus_topics: Fracture theory, fatigue, factor of safety, reliability, notch, dimension, surface and other factors
